skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept and research scope of business planning.
Understand the types of business activities and their roles.
Understand and grasp the approach to business planning, its functions and roles.
Describe the principles of business planning.
Apply the PDCA cycle in business planning.
Classify and clarify the characteristics of various business plans including strategic, operational, short-term, medium-term, long-term, comprehensive, and departmental plans.
Analyze planning methods in businesses and the use of KPIs.
Understand the content and process of developing a marketing plan in a business.
Understand the content and process of developing a production and supply plan in a business.
Understand the content and process of developing a human resources plan in a business.
Understand the content and process of developing a financial plan in a business.
Understand the concept and role of organizing plan implementation in a business.
Understand the steps for organizing plan implementation in a business.
Understand the methods for mobilizing resources for plan implementation in a business.
Understand tools for organizing plan implementation such as Gantt charts and PERT diagrams.
Select and forecast the processing and analysis of data on the business environment and financial reports to serve as a basis for planning and implementing plans.
Practice group work skills.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Reading, Writing, Presentation, and Debate Skills
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Practice reading, writing, presentation, and debate skills.
Develop self-learning and research skills.
Develop awareness of professional ethics and social responsibility.
